aboutHeading: Decades of Tile Restoration in Keilor East
aboutText: Melbourne Heritage Tiles, based in Keilor East, has dedicated decades to preserving the character of period homes through expert tessellated tile work. From full restorations to custom pattern matching, we serve home owners, builders, architects, and heritage bodies across Melbourne. Our commitment is to deliver floors that feel authentic and stand the test of time.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive tile services including restorations, replica tiles, custom patterns, and full supply-and-install. Serving home owners, builders, architects, and heritage authorities, we ensure period accuracy and quality craftsmanship for every project.

services.title: Tessellated Tile Restoration
services.desc: We restore original heritage tile floors, bringing back the timeless character of Victorian and Edwardian homes in Keilor East and across Melbourne.

services.title: Replica Tile Supply
services.desc: Supply of period-accurate replica tessellated tiles to match existing patterns and colours for heritage verandahs and floors.

services.title: Custom Pattern Design
services.desc: Custom pattern development to match existing floors and verandahs, ensuring authenticity and alignment with heritage specifications.

services.title: Full Supply & Installation
services.desc: Complete supply and professional installation of new tessellated tile floors for residential and commercial projects.

services.title: Heritage Home Projects
services.desc: Specialised restoration work for significant projects like Hawthorn verandah and Albert Park full floor restorations.

services.title: Client & Heritage Services
services.desc: Tailored services for home owners, builders, architects, and governments, including documentation and approval support.
